title: Validate the versioned Python Agent plan at the Swift boundary
goal: Add a strict Swift decoder and validator for schema_version 1 Python Agent plan envelopes so Python proposals can be consumed safely without gaining execution authority.
context: PYAGENT-001 adds a deterministic Python planner that emits a versioned JSON envelope. This task establishes the Swift-side contract boundary before any app wiring. Swift remains authoritative for Agent scope, Settings policy, approval, tool execution, and verification.
forbidden_changes: Do not invoke Python, tools, filesystem, shell, or network from this decoder.
Do not let Python proposals authorize capabilities or bypass existing Skill/Module policy and verification.
Do not wire this bridge into production Chat routing in this task.
Do not modify App/ or PersonalAgent.xcodeproj.
acceptance_criteria: Decode the exact schema_version 1 envelope emitted by AgentRuntimePython.
Reject unsupported schema versions and any plan with is_executable=true.
Accept only the allowlisted workspace.create-file proposal shape and reject path traversal or malformed arguments.
Clarification/chat/unsupported plans cannot carry Skill IDs or tool arguments.
Regression tests cover valid proposal, clarification, unsupported schema, executable flag, path traversal, and hidden arguments.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Keep the bridge as data validation only. If the Python envelope changes, bump the schema version explicitly and update cross-language fixtures; never silently accept an unknown contract.
